scope: Recommended vendor-neutral policy hooks. No collector or alert delivery configured.

rules.name: api-errors
rules.condition: 5xx / all requests > 5% for 5m with at least 100 requests
rules.action: Check readiness/dependency events, stop rollout if correlated

rules.name: dependency-unavailable
rules.condition: 3 consecutive readiness failures or dependency failures for 60s
rules.action: Check PostgreSQL/Redis availability, TLS and capacity; retain fail-closed controls

rules.name: worker-stalled
rules.condition: No heartbeat for 60s or oldestPendingSeconds > 300 for 5m
rules.action: Check worker process and disabled/provider transport state; inspect retry/expiry backlog

rules.name: worker-failures
rules.condition: 3 iteration failures within 60s or any terminal failed job
rules.action: Inspect fixed categories and protected job records; do not blindly resend externally

rules.name: checkout-failures
rules.condition: Failure ratio > 10% for 5m with at least 20 attempts; exclude expected conflict/rate-limit policy from paging totals
rules.action: Correlate dependency events, hold expiry/conflicts and payment boundary; production PAYMENTS_DISABLED is expected before integration

rules.name: abuse-spike
rules.condition: 3x environment baseline for 10m, after establishing a baseline
rules.action: Review HMAC identities and policy, preserve authentication/authorization checks

rules.name: migration-failure
rules.action: Stop rollout, preserve migration evidence, follow forward-fix/restore decision

rules.name: backup-failure-or-age
rules.source: external scheduler exit status + archive catalog
rules.condition: Any failed job or latest successful logical backup age > 26h; PITR gap > 5m if configured
rules.action: Verify archive/key separation and restore drill; scheduler and PITR are external prerequisites

rules.name: storage-pressure
rules.condition: Disk free < 20% or Redis memory > 80% for 10m, tune to provider limits
rules.action: Increase capacity safely; preserve Redis noeviction and do not disable abuse budgets

requiredBeforeDeployment: tested alert delivery and recovery notification
worker expiry backlog gauge from protected database/platform collection
